An introduction to philosophy through the close reading of selected classical texts.
Authors to be considered may include Plato, Descartes, Hobbes, Hume, Marx, Mill, Nietzsche.

The full notes can be found [here](/thoughts/university/twenty-three-twenty-four/philo-1aa3/All.pdf), with all of the reference [text](/thoughts/university/twenty-three-twenty-four/philo-1aa3/1A3Reader(2019).pdf).

Tutorial notes can be found [here](/thoughts/university/twenty-three-twenty-four/philo-1aa3/tut)
